user.title: Add a price forecast filter
user.description: Select an Amber Express price sensor, or another sensor publishing a forecast of timezone-aware time/value points. Its state must be the current price.

error.invalid_source: Select an available price sensor with valid, continuous time/value forecasts in $/kWh or c/kWh. A filter output cannot be used as its own upstream source.
error.already_configured: This source already has a filter.

abort.already_configured: This source already has a filter.

init.title: Configure price filtering
init.description: These settings express your operating preferences, not a measured probability that a spike will occur. Output uses $/kWh.

data_description.enabled: Turn off to publish the normalised source forecast unchanged.
data_description.preserve_hours: Intervals starting within this lead time keep their source price.
data_description.midpoint_hours: The distant-price retention curve reaches approximately half strength at this lead time. Must be later than the preserved window.
data_description.transition_hours: Controls how gradually time weighting changes and how quickly extra spike suppression grows after the preserved window.
data_description.minimum_retention: The fraction of distant deviations retained before extra spike suppression. Zero approaches the median baseline far ahead.
data_description.baseline_window_hours: Full width of the centred duration-weighted median. A brief extreme price does not move the median unless it occupies at least half the available window.
data_description.spike_scale: Deviation from the median at which extra spike suppression reaches about 63% of its configured maximum, before the lead-time ramp.
data_description.max_suppression: Extra fraction removed from a large distant deviation. 0.9 removes up to 90% after time weighting.
data_description.spike_direction: Select the sign of deviations that receive extra spike suppression. Time weighting applies to deviations in both directions.
data_description.max_source_age_minutes: Make output unavailable when the source has not reported within this time.

error.invalid_settings: Use finite values within the displayed ranges and set the time midpoint later than the preserved window.
